# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/artifacts/{artifact_id}

Marks a specific artifact for deletion (v4 only)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-297`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| artifact_id | path | string | True |

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Invalid request
- **404** — Artifact not found or is v3 format

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | getArtifactByPathParam | utility | Parse artifact_id, fetch by ID, validate repo and status |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | DeleteArtifact (v4 check + mark) | controller | Check IsArtifactV4; If v4: call SetArtifactNeedDeleteByID to mark status=PendingDeletion; If v3: return 404 |

### Datastore Operations

| Store | Type | Operation | Description |
|-------|------|-----------|-------------|
| [action_artifact](../datastores/databases.md#action_artifact) | database | SELECT | Get artifact by primary key |
| [action_artifact](../datastores/databases.md#action_artifact) | database | UPDATE | Set status=PendingDeletion where id=? AND status=UploadConfirmed |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Artifact must belong to the requesting repository and have valid status (confirmed or expired) | validation | !ok || art.RepoID != repo.ID || (art.Status != UploadConfirmed && art.Status != Expired) |
| Only v4 artifacts (content_encoding contains '/') are supported for single-artifact operations | validation | strings.Contains(art.ContentEncodingOrType, "/") |
| Artifact deletion is soft-delete: status changes to PendingDeletion, actual file removal by cron | state_transition | id=? AND status = UploadConfirmed |

### Error Paths

- **Artifact not found or wrong repo** → ctx.APIError → 404
- **Artifact is v3** → ctx.APIError → 404
- **SetArtifactNeedDeleteByID fails** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
